sources.games: 236 league games since 7.40 (7.41 alone had under 300) (data/heroes/item_stats), win 44.9%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py spectre.
sources.items: Valve /datafeed/itemdata, 7.41f: Monkey King Bar, Silver Edge, Mjollnir, Eye of Skadi, Aghanim's Scepter.
sources.player: Player review, 2026-10-19: against evasion Eye of Skadi first, then Monkey King Bar; Bloodthorn also works. Eye of Skadi against heavy healing (it is in the build). no generic Black King Bar or Silver Edge (audit).

rules.name: Eye of Skadi
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Eye of Skadi: +35 all attributes; attacks slow movement by 25% and attack speed by 25% and cut health restoration by 50% for 3 s. It is in her build (~32 min); high-rank Spectres against Phantom Assassin or Windranger: 56% of 27 games against them (32% otherwise), won 67% against 50% (27 games).

reason.en: {enemy} dodges attacks: take {item} first, its attributes and slow keep you alive while attacks miss, then answer the evasion
reason.uk: {enemy} ухиляється від атак: спершу візьміть {item} — його атрибути й уповільнення допоможуть вижити, поки атаки промахуються, а потім відповідайте на ухилення

rules.name: Bloodthorn

reason.en: {enemy} dodges attacks and {escape} escapes with {spell}: {item} silences the escape, and your attacks never miss the silenced target
reason.uk: {enemy} ухиляється від атак, а {escape} тікає через {spell}: {item} накладає тишу, і по цілі під тишею ваші атаки не промахуються

rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Bloodthorn: Soul Rend silences for 5 s and gives True Strike against the silenced target; the passive pierces evasion on 40% of attacks. Orchid is in her build (26%, ~29 min). The player review: Skadi first, Bloodthorn also works.

rules.name: Monkey King Bar

reason.en: {enemy} dodges attacks: with {item} most of your attacks go through the evasion
reason.uk: {enemy} ухиляється від атак: з {item} більшість ваших атак пробиває ухилення

rules.basis: Monkey King Bar pierces evasion on 80% of attacks, nothing to cast; without an escape hero beside the evasion it is the cheaper answer (5000 against 6400). The player review: Skadi first, then Monkey King Bar.

rules.name: Eye of Skadi

reason.en: {enemy} heals a lot: your {item} halves their health restoration, so keep it in the build
reason.uk: {enemy} багато лікується: ваш {item} удвічі ріже відновлення здоров'я, тож не пропускайте його

rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Eye of Skadi: attacks cut health restoration by 50% for 3 s (+35 all attributes, the slow). It is in the build (47% of the won games, ~32 min); high-rank Spectres against heavy healers: not among the 12 items bought more often in 41 games against them. The player review: Skadi against healing for every carry who has it in the build.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: magic_wand 91% (2), urn_of_shadows 39% (4), pers 23% (6), power_treads 100% (7), radiance 85% (18), yasha 97% (21), manta 94% (24), oblivion_staff 27% (27), orchid 26% (29), skadi 47% (32), basher 38% (36), black_king_bar 21% (36), butterfly 31% (39), sange 26% (40), abyssal_blade 26% (41).

tempo.basis: Gold lines where the hero wins 80.0%+: 20:00 11000 (16 games, 81.2%), 25:00 14500 (31 games, 80.6%), 30:00 18000 (38 games, 81.6%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold. The farmed games are few (16 by 20:00), so the tempo items follow the usual build. No 85% line for this hero (two of the three minutes needed): the hero's own 80% line (scripts/hero_item_stats.py WIN_TARGETS). The 20:00 point rests on under 20 games, so it is left out (PLAN_POINT_GAMES).

reason.en: Your net worth is {net_worth}, well ahead for this minute: {item} on the tempo build comes before the counters, then take the Aegis and push for the throne
reason.uk: Ваш нетворс — {net_worth}, набагато більше звичайного для цієї хвилини: спершу {item} з темпової збірки, потім заберіть Aegis і йдіть на трон

skills.basis: 236 games: maxed spectre_spectral_dagger > spectre_dispersion > spectre_shadow_step 171 (win 49.1%), spectre_spectral_dagger > spectre_shadow_step > spectre_dispersion 36 (win 44.4%), spectre_dispersion > spectre_spectral_dagger > spectre_shadow_step 10 (win 50.0%); talents 10: Desolate Damage 204/234 (45.1%), Spectral Dagger Cooldown 30/234 (43.3%); 15: Shadow Step Duration 139/211 (47.5%), Spectral Dagger Damage 72/211 (52.8%); 20: Spectral Dagger Slow/Bonus 54/65 (48.1%), +325 Health 11/65 (81.8%); 25: All Spectre Illusion Damage 58/73 (65.5%), Dispersion 15/73 (60.0%).

suppress.illusions: Radiance (85% of her won games, ~18 min) burns the illusions around her and Dispersion reflects their damage; high-rank Spectres do not add Maelstrom against illusion heroes.
suppress.magic: Black King Bar is not in her build; high-rank Spectres against 3+ magic damage heroes: not among the 12 items bought more often in 29 games against them. BKB still comes after two deaths under stuns (situational_items.py).
suppress.break: High-rank Spectres against Bristleback, Spectre or Huskar: Silver Edge not among the 12 items bought more often in 8 games against them; Radiance, Skadi and Abyssal are her build.
